about_section.heading: About This Scholarship
about_section.description:
The Kazakhstan Government Scholarship for Foreign Citizens is a prestigious, government-funded scholarship established on November 5, 1993 by the Presidential Decree of the Republic of Kazakhstan. This scholarship allows international students to study at leading universities across Kazakhstan with a study medium of English, Russian, or Kazakh.

Key Benefits

  • Government-sponsored scholarship place at a Kazakhstani university
  • Available for Bachelor’s (490 slots), Master’s (50 slots), PhD (10 slots)
  • Study at one of 37 leading universities in Kazakhstan
  • Access to 2,668 academic programs across multiple fields
  • Covers your full tuition fees, provides a monthly stipend for living and expenses
  • No separate language prep course (Russian/Kazakh taught as part of curriculum)
  • MBBS/General Medicine applicants are also eligible

coverages.description: The scholarship fully covers tuition fees for the entire duration of the approved study program at the selected foreign university.

A monthly stipend is provided — Bachelor's 110 USD, Master's ~220 USD, and PhD ~500 USD (expected to increase)."Stipend Condition"(You must score at least 70 out of 100 in all subjects every semester to maintain your stipend.)
Only bachelor's students are provided a bus card with a flat rate of 60 KZT per ride.(Not for Master's and PhD students, they pay the standard local fare of 120 KZT per ride.)
Accommodation is not covered — whether dorm or off-campus, all housing costs are paid by the student.
Visa renewal fee (~200 USD/year) is the student's own responsibility.
Daily living expenses such as food, utilities, and personal costs are not covered
Any personal or emergency expenses are entirely the student's responsibility.

documents_list.description: A written justification of your dissertation research topic, submitted in the language of instruction.

how_to_apply_section.title: How to Apply For The Kazakhstan Government Scholarship for International Students

points.description: Check Eligibility : Ensure you meet academic requirements (Bachelor’s: minimum “Good”; Master’s/PhD: GPA 3.0/4.0) and have a valid language certificate if required.
Prepare Documents : Collect all required documents: ID, transcripts, motivation essay, recommendation letters, medical certificate, and application form (PhD also needs research proposal).
Complete Application Form : Download and fill out the official form in Kazakh, Russian, or English
Apply Online : Submit your application online till 31 May 2026 via the official portal.
Selection Process : Applications are reviewed competitively; results are announced by the relevant authority.
Sign Contract : Selected candidates must sign the training contract within 90 days, or the scholarship will be canceled.
Secure Admission :Either apply to a university yourself or request placement assistance self-application is usually faster.
Appear for Online Psychological Assessment:  Complete it online through the portal or wait for further instructions — completing it promptly after application is usually faster.

about_section.description:
Diya Pakistan, meaning lamp in Urdu, has been illuminating futures since 1988. This non-profit tackles poverty at its root by keeping academically capable, but financially struggling students in education. Over the years, Diya has awarded more than 600,000 scholarships worth US$10.5 million across a network of 2,400+ schools, colleges, universities, and vocational institutes nationwide. A standout feature: since 2010, trustees cover all operational costs personally, meaning 100% of donations go directly to students. The organization is Shariah-compliant and Zakat-certified, making it a trusted choice for faith-conscious donors. Scholarships are merit-based, annually renewable, and designed to support students for as long as they stay enrolled and maintain their academic standards.

Key Benefits

  • Full or partial financial assistance for tuition and education-related expenses
  • Scholarship is paid every year (from 1st July to 30th June)
  • The cheque is dispatched directly to the student’s institute for safe delivery
  • Students can encash their cheque at any Meezan Bank branch across Pakistan
  • Scholarship is renewable; students receiving it can apply for continuation every year by submitting updated results and fee receipts
  • Students who are Hafiz-e-Quran receive an additional 5% weightage in their assessment

points.description: Read the Instructions. Visit diyapak.org/instruction-general and read all instructions thoroughly before starting your application.
Gather All Information and Documents Collect all required documents listed above. Make sure all scans are clear, in colour, and taken from original copies.
Fill the Online Application Form Go to diyapak.org/apply-scholarship and fill in your personal, guardian, academic, financial, and family details completely and honestly.

Download and Complete the HOI Form Download the Head of Institute Attestation (HOI) Form from Diya's Download page. Get it filled and stamped by your school, college, or university head, then take a clear scan or photo of it.
If your guardian is not a salaried person or pensioner, download the Enrollment Certificate for each enrolled sibling. These must be attested by their respective institutes and scanned.
Email all scanned documents to apply@diyapak.org. You must include your CNIC number in the subject line of the email so your documents can be linked to your application record.
Check your application status weekly on the Diya Pakistan website. If any clarifications or additional documents are requested, respond promptly.

Once approved, your cheque will be dispatched to your institute within 20 to 30 days. You can either encash it at any Meezan Bank branch (with your original CNIC) or have it adjusted against your fees by your institute directly.

about_section.heading: About This Scholarship
about_section.description:
The PEEF Master’s Level Scholarship is merit and need-based financial assistance for students pursuing Master’s degree courses awarded on a yearly basis. It aims to support talented and deserving students at partner universities and degree-awarding institutions in Punjab. The scholarship is designed to provide financial support students from low income families and to ensure that the economic challenges do not deter them from furthering their education.

Key Benefits

  • Financial assistance for Master’s level education
  • Support for students from low-income families
  • Opportunity to study at recognized partner universities
  • Equal eligibility across Morning, Afternoon, Evening, and Fall/Spring sessions
  • Special consideration for children of low-grade government employees and martyrs
